oneLiner: A personal tutor built around a child's dream, from real lessons an agent finds on the web.

pitch.who: curious pupils of 8 to 18 and their parents
pitch.need: want to learn further and faster than their class
pitch.benefit: turns a dream like Mars into lessons found on the web, taught aloud
pitch.alternative: one teacher has 25 pupils, and good lessons online are scattered and unchecked
pitch.difference: seven questions and H builds a tutor that shows its sources and remembers the child

moment.text: Andy, 11, asks his new tutor for his first Mars mission.
